content.rendered:
With the opening of our new high school and Transformation project buildings, please note that contact information may have changed for many of our buildings. Please refer to the following information to contact our school offices.

Sherwood High School

  • Main Office/General Questions: 503-825-6000 / award@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Registration/Enrollment: 503-825-6020 / sgrider@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Withdrawals: 503-825-6022 / tharbick@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Athletics: 503-825-6008 / cpollock@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Bookkeeping: 503-825-6012 / dbear@sherwood.k12.or.us

Sherwood Middle School

  • Main Office/General Questions: 503-825-5500 / jscoggin@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Registration/Enrollment/Withdrawals: 503-825-5520 / akopp@sherwood.k12.or.us

Archer Glen Elementary

  • Main Office/General Questions: 503-825-5102 / slemmert@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Registration/Enrollment: 503-825-5100 / jmorales@sherwood.k12.or.us

Hawks View Elementary

  • Main Office/General Questions: 503-825-5400 / lhogan@sherwood.k12.or.us -or- jpaine@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Registration/Enrollment: 503-825-5400 / lhogan@sherwood.k12.or.us

Middleton Elementary

  • Main Office: 503-825-5300
  • General Questions: 503-825-5302 / mwunnicke@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Registration/Enrollment: 503-825-5300 / mmulkins@sherwood.k12.or.us

Ridges Elementary

  • Main Office/General Questions: 503-825-5700 / kheckendorn@sherwood.k12.or.us -or- troeter@sherwood.k12.or.us
  • Registration/Enrollment: 503-825-5702 / lwright@sherwood.k12.or.us
